content.short: This one-time-only edition of 100 CNFTs represents five of the most significant secret societies.
content.description:
Secret societies are rooted in our everyday experience and secrecy is endemic in our society. Everyone loves secrets; to know things which other people don’t know. There is a feeling of power in being one of a few people who know and there’s satisfaction in knowing that you are one of the select few that belongs to an exclusive group.

This one-time-only edition of 100 CNFTs represents five of the most significant secret societies. Each of the five secret society symbols is minted in 20 different elements found on the periodic table.

The aim of these CNFTs is to build an exclusive community that is free to share ideas, opinions, invite new members or just provide a feeling of belonging; not unlike a secret society.

Ownership of the CNFT gives you exclusive access to ‘the inner sanctum’ SECRET_MASTER private chat channel where members, chat, discuss, share and vote on how to spend 10% of all royalties attained from the CNFT circulation.
